name: identical input follows PHP rather than diff
description: The one response in this domain that is deliberately not what `diff -U65535` would print, because diff prints nothing when the files match. PhabricatorDifferenceEngine synthesises its own string instead, so callers can still render the unchanged file, and its quirks are the contract: "a\nb\n" splits into three elements rather than two, so the count is 3 and the body ends with a context line holding a single space.
